title: Immerse yourself in your music with these Beats Solo 4 headphones for just $90
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get these Warm White (Open Box) Beats Solo 4 On-Ear Headphones for just $89.99 (reg. $199.99).

What is modern life without a good set of headphones? They’re a lifesaver for long commutes, working out at the gym, doing chores around the house, and even when you want to make a quick call without everyone around you getting involved. With these Beats Solo 4, you can do it all. We’re talking 50-hour battery life, spatial audio, and Bluetooth 5.3 connection for just $89.99 (reg. $199.99).

The Beats Solo 4 are designed for both powerful sound and ultra-lightweight comfort for activity-based flexibility. And thanks to the Personalized Spatial Audio feature and dynamic head tracking, the sound quality you receive will always be immersive.

They also come with Fast Fuel recharge, which gives you up to 5 hours of playback after just 10 minutes of charging. What’s more, the Beats Solo 4 seamlessly integrate with both iOS and Android to provide you with one-touch pairing, audio sharing, compatibility with device tracking features, and automatic pre-pairing across devices.

Part of the reason these headphones are such a great deal is that they’re Open Box. This just means they were categorized as excess inventory; and since this one is “new,” it’ll arrive with zero cosmetic flaws. So, why not give them a try?

Get these Warm White Beats Solo 4 (Open Box) for just $89.99 (reg. $199.99).
